The ultimate script for ,Fisch brings automation and efficiency to fishing with an array of powerful features. Dominate the waters with tools designed for speed, convenience, and seamless gameplay. Here's a breakdown of its functionalities:

Automatically fishes for you at incredible speed, maximizing your catch rate.
Works efficiently across all fishing spots.

2.Auto Sell Fish

Instantly sells all your caught fish for maximum earnings.
Removes the hassle of manual selling, saving time.

3.Teleports

Teleport to essential locations, including Fishing Areas, NPCs, Items, Totems, and more.
Navigate the game effortlessly without delays.

4.Anti-AFK

Prevents you from being kicked for inactivity, ensuring uninterrupted farming sessions.
Makes AFK farming completely discreet.

5.Infinite Oxygen

Enables unlimited oxygen while underwater, letting you explore or fish for as long as you want.

6.Freeze

Freezes your character in place to prevent falling or unwanted movement, ideal for precise farming setups.

7.Auto Appraiser

Automatically appraises equipped fish with ease.
Perfect for efficiently evaluating your catches without manual effort.

8.Collect Treasures

Automatically gathers all treasures scattered across the map.
Boosts your rewards by ensuring no valuable item goes unnoticed.

9.Create Safe Zone

Establishes a protective zone where you can't be attacked or interrupted.
Perfect for stress-free farming or strategizing.

10.Walk On Water

Enables your character to walk on water, granting unparalleled movement capabilities.

11.Bypass Fish Radar

Unlocks the fish radar without any cost.
Provides an advantage by showing all nearby fish instantly.

local Section = Tab:AddSection({Name = "List of players"})

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local playerList = {}

local function updatePlayerList()
    playerList = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(players:GetPlayers()) do
        table.insert(playerList, player.Name)
    end
end

updatePlayerList()

local selectedPlayer = nil

local playerDropdown = Section:AddDropdown({
    Name = "Select a Player",
    Options = playerList,
    Callback = function(value)
        selectedPlayer = value
    end
})

players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    table.insert(playerList, player.Name)
    playerDropdown:Refresh(playerList, true)
end)

players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    for i, playerName in ipairs(playerList) do
        if playerName == player.Name then
            table.remove(playerList, i)
            break
        end
    end
    playerDropdown:Refresh(playerList, true)
end)

})

})
